lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: VIP lounge with its own check-in counter and bar. Service on departure 4,600 ₽, on arrival 3,500 ₽. Administrator: +7 (85594) 6-35-16, round the clock.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Hotel on the airport grounds. A bed in a single or double junior suite 1,900 ₽ per day. Check-in at 16:00, check-out at 12:00. Free for children under 3.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room in the terminal is open round the clock.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The paid guarded car park is open round the clock.
